typedText: The train left the coast at six and reached the mountains before dark. Between the two there was nothing but fields, a few farms and the slow turning of the wind. He watched it all without saying a word.
There is a moment just before a storm when the air goes still and the birds stop singing. Everything waits. Then the first drop falls, and the whole afternoon changes shape in a matter of seconds.
